key_insight: Split complex-valued PINNs improve representation of amplitude and phase, reducing spectral bias and boosting accuracy on oscillatory nonlinear PDEs.
engineering_relevance: The method offers a more accurate and flexible surrogate for forward and inverse fluid and wave problems, including challenging high-frequency and high-dimensional regimes.
method: Use complex-valued network parameters and latent states.
Apply split activations separately to real and imaginary parts for stability.
Train on PDE residuals plus data/constraints for forward and inverse tasks.
evidence_signal: The paper reports broad benchmarking across Burgers, Allen-Cahn, KdV, nonlinear Schrödinger, Helmholtz, Poisson, Kovasznay flow, lid-driven cavity, Lorenz, inverse Burgers, inverse Navier-Stokes, and 3D Beltrami flow, with Beltrami reaching a relative L2 error of 4.07 × 10^-5.
watch_item: Complex-valued modeling can add implementation complexity and performance may depend on activation choice, sampling strategy, and problem scaling.
paper_title: Split Complex-Valued Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Forward and Inverse Nonlinear PDEs
